name: walmart-advisory
description: Retail Reason — a licensed, connected expert service for Walmart suppliers and sellers: 1P suppliers, 3P Marketplace sellers, and the advisors who serve them. This marketplace installs the thin client plugin; expertise is delivered by the hosted Retail Reason service (seat key required).

plugins.name: walmart-advisor
plugins.description: Retail Reason client for Walmart suppliers and sellers: expert answers on 1P supplier operations (onboarding, compliance, chargebacks, deductions, merchandising), Walmart supplier-facing data and analytics (Scintilla), Marketplace 3P selling, and the Supplier One portal — plus a pitfall check for any Walmart deliverable, a glossary lookup, and a fiscal-calendar converter. Requires a Retail Reason seat key.
